training_setup.optimizer: SGD, momentum 0.9 (nesterov), peak lr 0.1, weight decay 0.0005
training_setup.learning_rate_schedule: 2-epoch linear warmup, then cosine decay to 0 over 60 epochs
training_setup.augmentation: random crop (zero-pad 4) + random horizontal flip; per-channel mean/std normalization

task3.method: 5-fold cross-validated out-of-fold scoring with ResNet-18 (30 epochs/fold, noisy labels only); score = mean over epochs of the held-out negative log-likelihood of the given label
